Shared measurement rules (M references retain their original IDs):
- Freeze problem IDs, family/difficulty mix, interfaces, mutation/numerical and
  complexity requirements, independent oracles, budgets and candidate identity
  before qualification. No duplicate/paraphrase inflation of problem counts.
  Retain unsupported cases in the denominator. M1 may fit its known source
  corpus; that is representation qualification, not held-out solving.
- For M2–5, the primary result is the first emitted program, before repair or
  search. Report later attempts separately. Public checks can reject a program;
  independent scoring stays outside the query path. Abstentions and timeouts
  are unsolved. Zero observed wrong acceptances is a finite-sample target, not a
  proof of zero error; report uncertainty intervals and per-family outcomes.
- Input cost includes every literal needed for the complete program and its
  helpers, names, constants and syntax. Compute selection quantiles over
  independently correct assemblies, alongside coverage, and report cost for
  failed attempts too. The fallback fraction is single-character selection bits
  divided by all selection bits for those assemblies. No free source escapes,
  substitutions, hidden tables or problem-specific answer bodies disguised as
  helpers. Report entry sizes and reuse across distinct problems as well.
- Seven/eight bits buy **one selection**, not a whole solution. At eight bits,
  32 selections cost 256 input bits. Packet framing, padding and dictionary
  bytes are additional: the current codec charges **41 header bytes per
  program**. Report payload bits, complete packets, dictionary, decoder and
  model storage separately; show both one-program and amortized package costs.
  Human controls, navigation and correction inputs are an additional measured
  interaction cost, not free selections.
- Complete warm latency includes retrieval, prediction, assembly, validation
  and public checking. Freeze hardware, input lengths and check budgets;
  include timeout/abstention attempts rather than timing successes alone.
  Report cold startup, memory and offline library/training compute separately.
- M3 and M4 require fresh protected requirements and answers after development
  freezes. Familiar bases are allowed for variant tests; also report novel
  families separately. Preserve the existing protected 66-problem reservation;
  this plan neither opens nor replaces it. Report M4 by family/difficulty and
  familiar versus unseen composition, not only the aggregate.
One problem description produces its composition without human edits or query-time autoregressive generation.

Matched literature comparison requirements:
Use the [research map](../literals/RESEARCH.md) to select and pin strong implementations at
experiment freeze. FSST/OptFSST are encoding controls; Stitch/babble address
library learning; synthesis systems require a separate problem-to-program
comparison. Match source, allowed rewrites, data, representation constraints,
correctness requirements and runtime budgets where applicable. Parameterized
libraries and flat strings need separately labeled arms. Do not infer a
solving win from compressed bytes, or an algorithm-library win from punctuation.

For M5, predeclare comparator versions, adaptations, tuning budgets, cost
formula, datasets and statistical analysis. Charge all side information, with
model/decoder costs explicit. The paired 95% intervals must support the claimed
improvement, and preserve all failures. Three task sets means three distinct
populations, not three partitions of the same 20 examples. A method is not a
universal literature winner: the claim names the actual methods, tasks and
tradeoffs beaten. Numerical superiority alone does not establish novelty;
identify the new mechanism and isolate its contribution with ablations.

Preserve M4 scale and compactness on the algorithm track: at least 1,600/2,000 first-attempt correct across at least 25 predeclared families; at most 256 entries, median at most 24, p95 at most 64 selections, at most 5% single-character bits, zero whole-solution entries. This is scoped inheritance, not a prerequisite that all A4 latency/outcome gates passed in a separate run.

**Precise contribution and prior-art distinction.** State the mechanism, its domain and a falsifiable explanation of why it helps. Compare the actual mechanism against applicable tokenization, grammar/library-learning and equivalent-program methods, including ConvexTok and Casel where relevant. Distinguish a new result within Gamma from a defensible contribution beyond known methods.

**Attributable improvement or substantive new finding.** Use predeclared matched strong baselines, separate source/dictionary/joint ablations, fair compute and complete costs. Retain negative results, regressions and rival explanations. A useful impossibility/bound/counterexample claim needs its own valid argument; failed heuristic search is insufficient.

**Correctness and representation integrity.** Independently reconstruct outputs, validate semantics and complexity obligations, and charge every code/structural/decoder dependency. Claims about cyclic/recursive formats require termination and resource guarantees. Finite testing is labeled as such; formal claims require proofs or checkable certificates.

**Scope and external validity.** Freeze new evaluation populations before outcomes; include multiple relevant families and both language tracks when the claim is cross-language. Do not reuse exposed source/case optimization as unseen solving evidence. Generalization claims require independently authored reserved evaluation and all failures retained.

**Reproducibility and review.** Preserve exact code/data/dictionary/sequence identities, environment, search budget, solver tolerances/bounds, executable checks and a complete experimental account. Seek an independent reproduction and adversarial review appropriate to the claim. Release only material authorized for publication; private sources and protected evidence remain protected.

**Publication decision.** Produce a readable manuscript/artifact draft explaining the contribution, limitations and comparison scope. Root/owner review decides whether to submit or publish. This document authorizes neither submission, external messaging, deployment nor a public Git push; acceptance by a venue cannot be promised.
Measure acquisition, retention and delayed recall under a versioned stable codebook and declared practice budget. Readability or a 64-slot cap does not establish memorability.

Evaluate people solving independently selected unfamiliar problems without guided sequences or answer revelation. Seal task requirements/answers and track prior exposure separately from autonomous reservations; guided replay does not qualify.

Compare complete time to correct solution, inputs, errors, corrections, navigation and controls against ordinary coding under matched tasks, training and tooling. Include failures, uncertainty and participant-level outcomes; automated UI tests are mechanism evidence only.

Study macros, typed AST constructors and editor actions as separate representations with charged bindings, operands, scopes, control/navigation and decoder semantics. Preserve v1 macro whole-solution policy separately from literal/M1 whole-solution exclusions; do not inherit literal bit costs for hidden expansion.

Explore learned primitives or neural composition as a separately declared stretch representation under the same qualification, first-attempt, accounting and protected-evaluation gates. Charge model/decoder/operand costs. No relaxation of 4a/4b, presumed neural benefit or training authorization follows from this target.
